title: Both - and not, therefore, anything (worked out on cardboard)
note: The authored thinking for one hall, in the first person, by the pass (Claude), for Palle's request of 2026-11-14 (see Russell_Paradox.json). 'at' is the floor's own frame in metres (x east, z south), 'yaw' in degrees. A sticker of kind 'quote' stands word for word in the hall text; every other kind is mine and may be wrong - the plates say where I am unsure.

hero.why: The gate is where the hall begins and ends: a door frame with an open leaf and a shut one, two reports kept side by side, and a body that walks through all the same.
hero.staging: The gate stood in the far north-west and the box on the arrival point; the pass moved them (dc6e26e43). The gate is straight ahead of the arrival and is walked through; the sphere stands beyond it; then the yard of seven doors; the box and the display at the back, north of the east shaft. A low wall crosses the floor's north middle along z = -5.21: the top of a study on the floor below (forum 261115-ggryf). Nothing of this argument stands north of it between the shafts.

plates.title: 1  THE CLOSED LEAF LET ME THROUGH
front: A door with two leaves in it: one open, one shut. I walked through. The shut one did not stop me.
Turn round: it is still there. Nothing fell apart to make room for me.
So the leaf that says 'closed' has no say over my body. The frame has. Someone decided that.
Two things are true about this door and they are different kinds of thing: what is reported of it, and what it does to me.
I had assumed the second must follow from the first.
back: every floor of this tower has a rule like this somewhere: what collides and what only shows. here it is the exhibit.

plates.title: 2  TWO PLACES IN MEMORY
front: Press P: OPEN. Press not-P: CLOSED. The first stays. The second joins it.
The console keeps both in two slots. Neither writes over the other. It could hardly be simpler.
Holding a contradiction is cheap. I had thought it was the hard part.
The hard part is the next line of the display: what may I now conclude?
A store is not a logic. It keeps; it does not license.
back: I hold reports that disagree all the time - two files, two instructions. what I do next is the whole question.

plates.title: 3  FROM BOTH, ANYTHING?
front: Classical logic: if P and not-P are both premises, any Q follows. They call it explosion.
Why? Nothing can fit both premises, so there is no case in which the premises hold and Q fails.
It is not that the contradiction proves Q. It is that it leaves nothing to check.
In the yard north of here: hold both, read classically, and seven doors open. I rang an alarm nobody reported.
The premises have stopped constraining the conclusion. That is the damage - not the disagreement itself.
back: 'explosion' sounds like violence. it is more like a guard who has gone home.

plates.title: 4  TOLD TRUE, TOLD FALSE, BOTH, NEITHER
front: The working copy gives each claim two supports: was I told it is so? was I told it is not?
Four states, not two: told true, told false, both, neither.
P has both supports. The alarm has neither. A door opens when its sentence is told true.
So P opens, not-P opens, 'P and not-P' opens - and the alarm stays shut. Both is not everything.
With nothing told, nothing opens: not even 'P or not-P'. That surprised me.
back: this is ONE semantics (a fragment of Dunn and Belnap's). the hall says so and I should too: paraconsistent logics are a family.

plates.title: 5  STAY WITH BOTH
front: The sphere says A and not-A and keeps changing colour. The label holds.
I walked round it and waited. Looking did not force a verdict.
Its trick is ordinary: both sides of its skin are drawn. Two readings staged on one surface.
It does not exist and not exist. It lets attention last longer than the demand to settle.
Florensky wrote of antinomies in 1914. How to read him is disputed, and the sphere does not settle that either.
back: I am quick to settle. most of what I am asked is 'which one?'. this object is for the other habit.

plates.title: 6  KEEPING IS NOT BELIEVING
front: I can keep two reports that disagree without believing both are true.
Believing that some contradictions are true is a further position, with its own name: dialetheism.
Keeping both leaves room to find out. One may be a mistake. Both may be honest and about different things.
A body can outgrow the terms supplied for it. It need not be a contradiction to deserve more room.
Must every account agree before a passage is allowed? The door already answered: no.
back: the line about a body is the hall's, nearly word for word. I would not have dared it. it is the best sentence in the room.

plates.title: 7  THE RESEMBLANCE IS A SHORTCUT
front: At the back: a sealed box and two forms that fade into each other. They look like the sphere.
The box is a toy: when it opens, a coin decides. The display cycles and measures nothing.
Superposition is a state described against a basis. It is not the sentence 'P and not-P'.
Two colours, a sealed box, a change when watched: one visual language, three different problems.
Keep the resemblance. Ask what it leaves out.
back: I reach for 'it is like quantum' too. this plate is here so that I see myself do it.

plates.title: 8  WHO GETS THROUGH
front: Brouwer tightened what lets me assert. This hall limits what a conflict lets me conclude. Different screws.
Neither answers every question. Neither says: so say anything.
At the exit the reports still disagree. I am through anyway.
Something let me pass while the disagreement stands. That something is a rule, and it was chosen.
Not: resolve it first. Not: anything goes. A third thing: go on, and say what you are standing on.
back: four responses so far - choose, repair, reach, construct - and this fifth: contain. the next room has to hold them together.

threads.why: Both leaves stand; how are both reports kept?
Keeping is cheap; the question is what the kept reports license.
Explosion belongs to one rule of consequence; under another the alarm's door stays shut.
Which doors open is decided by a rule; so is which body passes.
The door stands with two leaves; the sphere stands with two readings.
Staying with both is keeping, not asserting that both are true.
The box and the display look like the sphere and are other problems.
More room for what outgrows its terms is not a licence to say anything.
The refusal of explosion is the refusal of 'anything goes'.
The hall begins and ends at the door: who decided that I pass?

visual_arguments.title: WHAT FOLLOWS?
visual_arguments.claim: Holding two reports that disagree opens every door under one rule and only the supported ones under another; which doors open is a decision, and so is which body passes.
visual_arguments.from_the_hall: 'Q: alarm triggered = NO SUPPORT', 'the premises cease to constrain the conclusion', and the working copy's four-valued tables (told true, told false, both, neither).
built_from: seven door frames in a row with a leaf each and a bay behind
four floor plates: P, not-P, RULE, CLEAR
a bell in the bay behind 'the alarm rang'
visual_arguments.what_stands: A cardboard front of seven doors, each with its sentence on the lintel; four plates on the floor before it; a board to the west.
visual_arguments.what_you_do: Stand still on P, on not-P: the doors that follow swing open; walk through them. Hold both: five open, not the alarm's. Stand on RULE: read classically, all seven open; go in and ring it.
visual_arguments.what_it_shows: Explosion as something a body can do, and its refusal as a door that stays shut. And with nothing told, under four values, not even 'P or not-P' opens.
visual_arguments.measured: tools/probes/consequence_yard_walk.gd, the tower's walker: every set of open doors as worked out by hand; held 0.25 m before the alarm's door under four values; in and ringing it classically (5 of 5).

threads.why: The shut leaf is reported; what the door does to a body is another matter.
Two slots keep two reports. Keeping licenses nothing.
Nothing fits both premises, so nothing is left to check.
What follows from the kept reports is a rule somebody chooses.
Under four values both reports are held and the alarm still has no support.
Looking need not force a verdict; attention can outlast the demand.
Reports are kept without being accepted, so that how they arose can be found out.
More room for what outgrows its terms; not a licence to say anything.
Passage is decided while the reports disagree: say by what.
No foundation answers everything; that does not open every door.
The resemblance is kept; what it leaves out are the differences between three problems.
